Isolated browser built around minimal permissions (Internet only), DocumentStart anti-fingerprinting, and zero background telemetry.

• Tap + to wipe the current session and rotate your fingerprint seed.\n• Pull down at the top of a page to reload.\n• Open ⋮ for screenshots, Find in page, and Settings.
Choose default storage for screenshots. You can change this anytime in Settings.

• App isolation: stored in private app sandbox (filesDir/captures). Other apps with photo permissions cannot read them.

• No MediaStore metadata: Gallery indexes creation time and owner package name (com.nromanovich.stealthsnake).

• No cloud auto-upload: prevents Google Photos or OEM cloud backup from syncing screenshots.

• Wipe-ready: can be cleared automatically when wiping your session.
Cookies, cache, storage, and history will be cleared and a new fingerprint seed will be generated.
Disable to keep logins (cookies) between app launches.
Enables FLAG_SECURE: hides Recents preview and blocks screen capture.
Off by default to block silent downloads. Saves to Downloads/StealthSnake.
Lightweight Android browser focused on isolation, minimal permissions, and blocking silent data collection.
Max Stealth enables all defenses; Compatibility eases strict checks.
Opens on launch and Home tap (use about:blank for blank).
Darkens bright websites automatically. Turn off if a site looks inverted or hard to read.
Removes hidden in-app screenshots whenever you wipe the session.
Asks before clearing cookies, history, and cache so you do not wipe by mistake.
Prevents the screen from sleeping while reading long pages.
Short vibration when taking a screenshot or wiping the session.
Shows a thin bar under the address field with blocked tracker count.
Blocks known ad, analytics, and telemetry domains before they load.
Prevents WebRTC from leaking your local Wi-Fi or VPN IP.
Blocks background pings sent when closing or leaving a page.
Adds per-session noise to Canvas/WebGL to vary your fingerprint.
Adds noise to WebAudio output to block audio fingerprinting.
Reports the tab as always active, hiding app switches.
Blocks resize events to hide window geometry and keyboard height.
Returns neutral values instead of live motion/orientation sensors.
Rounds timers to 20 µs to hinder timing attacks.
Adds subtle idle micro-scrolls to mimic natural reading.
Blocks links like intent:// or tel: from launching other apps behind your back.
Silences annoying alert/confirm/prompt popups from web pages.
Staying on Max Stealth is recommended

Max Stealth works on most websites. If a specific site has a compatibility issue, it is better not to relax all defenses at once: check the fix guide to see which option helps, and adjust it in a separate profile via "+".
Saves your switch setup. Long-press a profile to delete.
Blocks HTTP/HTTPS without an active VPN. For full socket protection, enable Always-on VPN in Android.
Opens start page immediately (network requests stay blocked until VPN connects).
VPN Kill-Switch is active. All page loads and network requests are blocked until a VPN tunnel connects.
Find what broke on a website, understand why it happens under strict privacy protections, and change only the exact setting in a custom profile ("+") instead of weakening everything.
Try simpler keywords (e.g. "captcha", "webrtc", "keyboard", "dark", "vpn") or reset the category filter.
Captcha loops, bot checks, or broken 2D/3D editors
Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha, or reCAPTCHA keeps failing/looping; Figma, online photo editors, or WebGL maps show pixel artifacts or refuse to render.
Canvas/WebGL noise subtly alters pixel readouts (getImageData, toDataURL, readPixels). Anti-bot scripts compare expected hashes, and graphic editors rely on exact pixel math.
Settings → Fingerprint → turn off "Noise Canvas & WebGL". If a login captcha still loops, also check "Lock visibilityState" or enable "Micro-Jitter".
Video/voice calls, screen share, or P2P transfers fail
Google Meet, Zoom Web, Discord, or Jitsi cannot connect audio/video; Snapdrop/ShareDrop peers are invisible; microphone/camera stream stalls.
Blocking WebRTC local ICE candidates prevents RTCPeerConnection from discovering local/VPN network interfaces and negotiating direct media streams.
Settings → Network → turn off "Block WebRTC local ICE candidates" (best done in a dedicated "Calls" custom profile).
Payments, OAuth logins, or embedded widgets do not load
"Sign in with Google/GitHub", Stripe/PayPal checkout, comment widgets, or embedded video players stay blank or hang endlessly.
The built-in blocklist blocks tracker, ad, and telemetry domains at the request level. Some sites bundle auth, checkout, or player scripts through those third-party domains.
Settings → Network → temporarily turn off "Built-in tracker blocklist" in a site profile, then turn it back on after checkout/login.
Missing images, fonts, or broken layout from custom rules
A specific website loses all styling, icons, fonts, or fails API calls after you added domains to your custom blocklist.
Broad substring rules (e.g. "google" or "cdn") can accidentally match essential subdomains like gstatic, fonts, or static asset hosts.
Settings → Network → "Custom blocklist domains": replace broad words with exact hostnames (e.g. metrics.example.com).
Drafts not saved on exit or form submission hangs
Closing a tab loses unsaved text/progress, logout fails to register, or certain anti-bot checks stall after clicking Submit.
Blocking navigator.sendBeacon and ping requests drops background fire-and-forget requests triggered when navigating away.
Settings → Network → turn off "Block sendBeacon & telemetry pings".
Web synthesizers, audio editors, or sound tests glitch
Browser DAWs, frequency visualizers (AnalyserNode), tone generators, or mic-check pages produce crackles or wrong spectrum readings.
WebAudio noise perturbs AudioContext buffer/frequency outputs to defeat audio fingerprinting, which affects DSP tools that read exact samples.
Video keeps playing in background or chat notifications stop
Media players do not auto-pause when switching apps, web chats never mark messages unread/send alerts, or proctoring/banking forms miss focus/blur validation.
Hiding visibilityState/hasFocus forces the page to believe the tab is always active and focused, suppressing real blur and visibilitychange events.
Settings → Fingerprint → turn off "Hide visibilityState & focus".
Keyboard covers input fields or layout scales wrong
On-screen keyboard hides the text box you are typing in, modals clip off-screen, rotation does not reflow the page, or touch coordinates miss on maps/canvases.
Viewport lock suppresses window resize events and freezes reported innerWidth/screen metrics so websites cannot probe keyboard height or screen geometry.
Settings → Fingerprint → turn off "Lock viewport & block resize events".
360° panoramas, compass, or tilt controls do not respond
Street View/VR panoramas stay frozen when moving the phone, map compass does not rotate, or mobile anti-fraud checks complain about zero motion.
Sensor fallback feeds calm synthetic values to DeviceMotion and DeviceOrientation APIs instead of live gyroscope/accelerometer data.
Settings → Fingerprint → turn off "Neutralize motion & orientation sensors".
Stuttering 60fps animations, game lag, or skewed speedtests
WebGL games or smooth animations jitter, audio/video drifts out of sync, or latency/speed tests report erratic ping numbers.
Fuzzing performance.now() rounds high-resolution timers to 20 microseconds, which can confuse tight frame-delta loops or sub-millisecond benchmarks.
Settings → Fingerprint → turn off "Fuzz performance.now() timers".
Page twitches slightly or dropdowns close while reading
Long articles scroll by a pixel on idle, text selection resets, or open <select> / autocomplete menus unexpectedly dismiss.
Micro-Jitter injects periodic tiny touch/scroll activity at your configured min/max interval so idle sessions do not look robotic.
Settings → Behavior → turn off "Micro-Jitter idle activity" or increase the Min/Max interval seconds.
"Open in app", bank payment, or tel:/mailto: links do nothing
Tapping Telegram links, banking/SBP payment buttons, phone numbers (tel:), or email links (mailto:) stays inside the browser with no action.
Blocking external URI schemes (intent://, tg://, tel:, mailto:) prevents websites from silently launching external Android apps.
Settings → Behavior → temporarily turn off "Block external app schemes" to complete the handoff, then re-enable it.
Delete, logout, or confirm buttons on older sites do nothing
Clicking "Delete", "Log out", or actions in router admin panels / phpMyAdmin has no effect and never asks for confirmation.
Suppressing JS dialogs automatically blocks/cancels alert(), confirm(), and prompt(), so scripts waiting for confirm() === true abort the action.
Settings → Behavior → turn off "Suppress JS alert/confirm/prompt".
All pages blocked by VPN screen or 403 error (including local LAN)
Every site shows the "VPN is disconnected" overlay, or Orbot/SOCKS proxy traffic fails, or local router addresses (192.168.x.x) cannot be opened.
VPN Kill-Switch verifies that Android\'s active network has TRANSPORT_VPN. Local proxies without a VPN interface and LAN gateways without a tunnel are blocked.

Connect a VPN app and tap "Check again", or temporarily turn off Settings → VPN → "Block requests without VPN". Note: "Open start page without waiting" only skips the startup check, not network blocking.
Inverted colors, unreadable text, broken zoom, downloads, or search
Photos/logos look inverted or dark text sits on a dark background; cards overlap; PDF/file downloads do not start; typing words in the URL bar does not search.
Force dark mode alters page CSS/images; high text zoom breaks rigid layouts; downloads are off by default for safety; search can be set to Off or an invalid Custom URL without %s.
Settings → Everyday: turn off "Force dark mode", reset "Text zoom" to 100%, enable "Allow file downloads" when needed, or verify your Search Engine (Custom URL must include %s).
Logged out after closing app or screenshots missing in Gallery
Every app restart signs you out of accounts and empties shopping carts; newly taken screenshots do not appear in the system Gallery.
Auto-Wipe on exit erases cookies, storage, cache, and rotates the fingerprint seed when leaving. Hidden storage saves screenshots privately inside the app.
Settings → Session: turn off "Auto-Wipe on app exit" to keep logins. Settings → Capture: switch destination to "Gallery" or export from the in-app Hidden Screenshots viewer.
